allow: PowerShell(npx next lint --dir app --dir lib --dir components 2>&1)

PowerShell(npm run lint 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15; "=== BUILD ==="; $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="https://placeholder.supabase.co"; $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="placeholder"; npm run build 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "error|Error|warn|Warning|Compiled|Failed|✓|✗" | Select-Object -First 40)

PowerShell([System.GC]::Collect\(\); Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="https://placeholder.supabase.co"; $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="placeholder"; $env:NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=2048"; npm run build 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "Compiled|Failed|error occurred|Generating static|Route \\\(app\\\)|paging|Turbopack" | Select-Object -First 20)

PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Id -ne $PID } | Sort-Object WorkingSet -Descending | Select-Object Id, @{N='MB';E={[int]\($_.WorkingSet/1MB\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; "--- Free memory \(MB\): ---"; [int]\(\(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem\).FreePhysicalMemory/1024\))

PowerShell(Remove-Item Env:\\NODE_OPTIONS -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [System.GC]::Collect\(\); Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="https://placeholder.supabase.co"; $env:NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="placeholder"; npm run build 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "Compiled successfully|Failed to compile|Route \\\(app\\\)|out of memory|paging|oral-exams|treatment-plan|work-done|treatments" | Select-Object -First 30)
